Name: LenovoFoDKeyCollection
Description: Hand-built: two activation keys spelled as Lenovo's LenovoFoDKey schema names its leaves (plan Appendix B: IdTypes[], Identifier, DescTypeCode, Status, Expires, UseCount, UseLimit, Bytes[]) — one with every leaf, one serving none. The lab SE350 serves an empty Keys collection and no populated key has been observed, so each <placeholder:...> string stands for a value this repository has not seen served; every other value is an invention. Identifier and Bytes are seeded to prove they never reach raw, context or a key.
